name: Wehingen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Wehingen (a white wing above a zigzag bar on blue).
history: The arms were first granted in 1930; the wing was added in 1961 to distinguish them from those of Tieringen. The banner is white-blue with the arms.

features.role: Wehingen arms — wing and zigzag bar on blue
